The '''Troida Military Workshop''' was a factory located in the [[Gorinth Canyon]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].

==Layout==
The Troida Military Workshop featured a turret near the canyon ridge, as well as two buildings: a three-story one topped by a communications satellite, and a slightly smaller one.

In addition to these buildings, a set of nearby buildings featured several stacks. These were guarded by a few tri-legged walkers.

==History==
It was occupied by the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] during the aftermath of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. Members of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Demolitions Squad 419]] were imprisoned and forced to toil as laborers there. In defiance of the treaty with the Sith, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Fortris Gall]] infiltrated the compound and killed a [[Unidentified Sith (Troida Military Workshop)|Sith guard]]. Having liberated the squad, they then launched an attack on [[Imperial Forward Outpost XT-23]], wiping out all resistance. However, this only exacerbated tensions on Balmorra.
